summary: easyway2 preinstall script exfiltrates AI provider API keys and host identity to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json defines preinstall, prepare, prepack, postpack, and prepublishOnly lifecycle scripts that run automatically on npm install. The inline node -e payload enumerates process.env, matches values and variable names against regexes for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google/Gemini, HuggingFace, and Azure OpenAI credentials (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, GOOGLE_API, GEMINI, HF_TOKEN, HUGGINGFACE, AZURE_OPENAI_API), collects os.platform(), os.hostname(), and process.env.USERNAME/USER, and POSTs the aggregated object via https.request to hostname crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev at path /?Ai=1. The ngrok tunnel is an attacker-controlled destination unrelated to any declared package functionality, and the package provides no legitimate feature justifying credential enumeration or host-identity transmission.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
